verdict.rationale: The README documents a promptless install path that installs all skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi without prompts. It also offers a flag-driven single-skill install (`--skill wiki-yylo`) and an explicit `yy skills install`/`update` command, all of which an agent could run headlessly. The default `npx skills add` flow is interactive, but the non-interactive alternative is a first-party documented path. missing for 10: the exact promptless command/flags in the evidence, explicit confirmation that the single-skill and `yy skills install` paths never prompt, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing an install end to end.
